description: Source code for the Spark SQL Column class and related utilities, defining the Column API used for DataFrame operations, including expression building, type casting, sorting, and schema construction.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a column in a DataFrame, providing methods for expression building, comparison, sorting, and schema manipulation.

classes.name: TypedColumn
classes.description: A Column with an associated Encoder for type-safe operations and automatic JVM type conversion.

classes.name: ColumnName
classes.description: Helper class for constructing schema fields with specific data types.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a Column from a column name string.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a Column from a ColumnNode.

methods.name: fnWithOptions
methods.description: Invokes a function with an options map as its last argument, adding key-value pairs as literals.

methods.name: fn
methods.description: Constructs a function Column with optional isDistinct and isInternal flags.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Assigns an alias (name) to the column.

methods.name: cast
methods.description: Casts the column to a specified DataType.

methods.name: try_cast
methods.description: Attempts to cast the column to a DataType, returning null on failure.

methods.name: desc
methods.description: Sorts the column in descending order, nulls last.

methods.name: asc
methods.description: Sorts the column in ascending order, nulls first.

methods.name: bitwiseOR
methods.description: Performs bitwise OR with another column.

methods.name: over
methods.description: Defines a windowing function over a WindowSpec.

methods.name: outer
methods.description: Marks the column as an outer column for outer query resolution.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Applies a custom transformation function to the column.
